purpose: Score Add restaurant-hours enrichment against independently collected hours and regular closure evidence. Preserve source wording and conflicts; do not infer missing hours or merge incompatible schedules.

evidence.note: Official page states schedule for weekdays, weekends, and holidays. Structured opening-hours data likewise lists all seven weekdays; no fixed weekly closure is listed. Last entry is kept separate from closing time and lunch last order. The absence of a stated weekly closure is not an assertion of no rest days.

Tabelog conflicts with the official page for Sunday/holiday dinner close (22:00 vs 23:00) and weekend/holiday last entry (21:00 vs official all-day 21:30). Its listed closure is 年末年始, a seasonal closure rather than a weekly closed day; retained as a source statement, not converted into regularClosingDays.
Current Tabelog entry reports weekday hours and weekend/holiday closures. It distinguishes the listed opening interval from its entry-time slots; no last-order time is stated.

evidence.quote: 来店日の前日午前8時より翌日分の予約を受付開始、各枠の1分前迄予約受付可能です。
evidence.note: Official booking page confirms reservation-window rules, but the accessible page does not state a regular opening-hours or weekly-closure schedule. Tabelog's note gives bookable entry times as 8:45～14:00, while its current hours/entry-time fields also include 8:15; preserve both as source differences rather than treating reservation slots as opening hours.

evidence.quote: 〖営業時間〗月〜金 08:45-14:30 土日祝 定休日
evidence.note: A Tabelog review dated 2024/10 states a different weekday start (08:45) from the current store-hours listing (08:15). This is an older review statement and is retained as a discrepancy, not merged into the current listing schedule.
